title: Partially Funded LESA Installment Calendar
content:
Among the plans of Set-Aside Accounts, only the Partially Funded LESA pays its funds to the borrower in semi-annual installments, so that the borrower can pay the property charges personally. The calendar and the sizing basis below are the plan settings for those installments.

| Plan | Pays semi-annual installments to the borrower | Installment months | Day of the installment month | How each installment is sized |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | No | None | 0 (none) | Not applicable |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | No | None | 0 (none) | Not applicable |
| Partially Funded LESA | Yes | June and December (months 6 and 12) | 1 | Half of the annual installment, fixed at closing |
| Repair Set-Aside | No | None | 0 (none) | Not applicable |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | No | None | 0 (none) | Not applicable |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | No | None | 0 (none) | Not applicable |

## Notes on the calendar

1. Under the Partially Funded LESA, an installment falls on day 1 of June and on day 1 of December.
2. The installment amount is fixed at closing as half of the annual installment; it is the semi-annual installment amount recorded on the set-aside when it was established.
3. A plan showing "None" and day 0 pays no installment to the borrower at any time of year.

**Hypothetical example.** A Partially Funded LESA whose closing figures fixed an annual installment of 2,400.00 carries a semi-annual installment amount of 1,200.00, scheduled for 1 June and 1 December.
